meaning:
1) downwards, below
1a) downwards
1b) under (of age)
1c) beneath

renderings.kjv: and thou shalt not be beneath

elsewhere.note: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God…
The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

“After all that has come on us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have…
The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
